titulo: Trump insists US government has ‘no reason to believe’ Huang’s return to Nvidia poses a national security risk – live

Rallies for AI stocks had the Nasdaq composite up a market-leading 6.5%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1,117 points.
